content: Sauga Yehoba Deibid i pwamwalem ana topihigelgel gegewel ge Sol nimaliyaa, inoke wona ya i wonaan Yehoba elana,

content.text: Yehoba i ola no pat mihahaina, no ababunsumi ge iya i aheyauem nak elana;
no Yabowaine i ola no pat ge no abalou tuk, o ligovan ge no topwamwal gasigasisena.
Iya no sivesive, no abalou ge no topwamwal, iya i pwamwalau toginol naknak elal.
Ya yoga ha Yehoba elana, iya alana ta tobalan, ge i pwamwalau o topihigelgel eliyalil.
Yaomal i ola bagol i bini pwatawa; nak i ola alol i yaleyau.
Tuma
i ola hihiu i avanau; yaomal i ola kimul i kota hikagau.
No minanakina hot elana ya yoga ha Yehoba elana; ya yoga no Yabowaine elana.
Yaka anau i hagoem wana limi bwabwalena elana; no kahin labe kaiwena i laeganan.
Yaka panayawi i lomwaniknik ge i tulutulu, ge labulabum ana wauwau i lamwalamwaniu, kaiwena Yabowaine i huga.
Inoke i ola kasu i tagilem buhunaa; hiwo memena i tagilem awanaa ge gibwal kalakalasina i ligin lowan.
Labulabum i pwela yaka i nem i lau; yaluyalu bibikena i minaa aena gabulanaa.
Wana nem i ola i heheya anelose elana ge i yoyou; i ola i gagavai leuleu elana.
Tuwana i os gogou elana ge milil leuleuina yaluyalu bibikel elal.
Mwananal bwabwatana i yana awonaa ge pinamal i lilitautau i tagilem elana.
Yehoba Tomihahaina Hot i baaba, anana i ola gulumwawa i loem labulabumwa.
Pinamal i ola egipoyo gauina i alihin, yaka ana topihigelgel nuwaliya i pagewagewa ge hi lou.
Hoga i kevakeva gunina i masal ge panayawi ana wauwau i mwananal bosowaina ta kite,
kaiwena Yehoba i ba haveyan ge wana huga elana i ba lala.
Nimana i paelu lowanem natiya ge i pihikagau, yaka i momol heyagau banata gasigasisena elana.
I pwamwalauem o topihigelgel gasigasisel elal, heliya hi huga eliyau ge hi gasisi lakeyau.
Hi mikausau ya minaa nak gamwanaa, yaa Yehoba iya o tolabe.
I aheyauem nak elana ge i teleyau labi waiwaisana elana; i pwamwalau, kaiwena i yaliyaya kaiweu.
Yehoba i hehegan bubun eliyau kaiwena no ginol i sapu, ge o mulolu i pem kaiwena nige nak ya giginol.
He Yehoba wana kamwasa ya toulil, nige ya gegegi ge no Yabowaine ana en ya pepek.
Wana logugui gegewena ya nuwahikagil ge ali baaba nige ali en ya pepek.
Nige o woliwoli i gagan matanaa ge ya matahikagau bahi gegi na giginol.
Yehoba o mulolu i pem kaiwena no ginol i sapu, ge nige nak ya giginol, ya henapu matanaa.
Bolo wam baaba hi henapuan, owa u nunuwana-agil, bolo nige nak u pwapwawaa elal, owa nige nak u giginol elal.
Bolo wali ginol i sapu, owa wam pagan i sapu elal, yaa bolo hi sigasiga, owa u teli gegetoga elal.
Bolo hi hanalau u pwamwalil, yaa bolo hi hanaha u kite hikagil ge u teli lowagil.
O Yehoba, owa u ola no odam, inoke no gogou u payane.
Wam labe eliyana, bosowaiu na tagalaka tolohaveyan ali boda elal, ge owa no Yabowaine wam gasisi eliyana, bosowaiu panuwa ana gana na mwena likaan.
Yabowaine, iya wana pagan bwalibwaligena i waisi; Yehoba wana baaba i tunahot. Iya i ola ligovan bolo hi lou tuk elana kaiweliya.
Nige Yabowaine etega al, iyai te Yehoba, nige pat abalou etega al, iyai te wala Yabowaine.
Yabowaine iya i pagasisi-agau ge no kamwasa i pwamwananal.
I labeyau aeu ya pilibubun mananaknak elal i ola diya;
i labeyau ya mwena ha ya talmilil oya pwataliyaa.
Haveyan ana kamwasa i pankiteyau; i pagasisi-agau bosowaiu egipoyo eloelolina na momol ge gauina na alihin.
Wam pwamwal i ola o ligovan; u labeyau yaka eliyana ya gasisi.
Kamwasa i magaga u pwela awowa, yaka ya nobubun nige aeu ya hahanapil.
O topihigelgel ya takel ge ya apapanak-agil, nige ya sisikalek ewa ana siga ya pwamowasel.
Ya gopasogol nige bosowailiya nihi lut; hi sogu hi minaa aeu gabulanaa.
U pagasisi-agau haveyan kaiwena, ge o topihigelgel u nulil hi kululuwa aewa.
U ba o topihigelgel hi lou matawa, ge bolo hi hugaagau ya apapanak-agil.
Labe kaiwena hi yoga, yaa nige gamagal etega bosowaina ni pwamwalil; hi yoga Yehoba elam yaa nige analiya u lalahe.
Ya pimukumuku-agil hi ola bilibili papakovana; ya pulilolowagil hi ola pweyapweya kamwasaa.
U pwamwalauem no gamagalau bolo hi teli gegetoga elau nimaliyaa; u matahikagau ya tabwa boda tomaha ona wali tohouwa.
Gamagalau bolo valila nige ya aatenal, sauga ya hi minaa no logugui gabulanaa;
toloha ginebi wali lovakun hi kululu eliyau, ge ebo ya baaba elal, no logugui hi toulil.
Wali atimatuwa i mowasi, yaka wali sivesive hi eguluwan alona wali ginu hi nem elau.
Yehoba i mihot! Iya Pat no abalou ta tobalan! No Yabowaine, iya Pat no abamwal, alana ta latahin!
Bolo hi ginol panak elau Yabowaine i tagalahi elal, boda ona i telel no logugui gabulanaa,
ge i sokalauem o topihigelgel elal.
O Yehoba, u oeyau bolo hi hahaveyan elau nimaliyaa; u pwamwalauem toginol naknak elal.
Inoke na tobalagiwa boda ona gamwaliyaa; ge alam ana tobal na wonaan.
Yehoba i labeyau nau kin o topihigelgel ya pakokovel hoti; wana atilomwan i gangan wana hilihili gamagalina nau Deibid elau, ge tubutubuwau elal nige ni momowasi.

footnotes.text: 1 Samuela 28:19 ana epwamwananal paiya nu kite.
Bwasumu diya bwasumu ana awa waiwaisana etegana. I patalelu aena i mweyaha ge ana kite i yaliyaliyaya. Bwagana bilibili ni lohanahanal, nige ni lolopinkoka.
